mapper.select:
select qb.qc_status as type, count(0) as count from qc_bill qb
qb.is_deleted = false
and qb.qc_date >= #{params.dateList[0]} and (#{params.dateList[1]}::TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '1 DAY' ) > qb.qc_date
group by qb.qc_status

select case when #{type} = 'day' then to_char(qb.qc_date::DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') when #{type} = 'week' then to_char(date::DATE-(extract(dow from qb.qc_date::TIMESTAMP)-1||'day')::interval, 'YYYY-mm-dd') when #{type} = 'month' then to_char(qb.qc_date::DATE, 'YYYY-MM') as dateStr, qb.qc_status as status, count (0) as count from qc_bill qb
qb.is_deleted = false
and qb.qc_date >= #{beginDate} and (#{endDate}::TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '1 DAY' ) > qb.qc_date
group by dateStr, qb.qc_status

select case when qb.qc_user_name = '' then '尚未分配' else qb.qc_user_name end as qcUserName, count(0) as qcTotalQty, sum (case when qb.qc_status = 'finishQc' then 1 else 0 end) as qcFinishQty, sum (case when qb.qc_status = 'waitQc' then 1 else 0 end) as qcWaitQty, sum (case when qb.qc_status = 'exemption' then 1 else 0 end) as qcFreeQty, sum (case when qb.qc_date::timestamp + '1 day' >= qb.qc_finish_time then 1 else 0 end) as qcTimelyQty, sum (case when qb.qc_finish_time > qb.qc_date::timestamp + '1 day' and qb.qc_status in ('finishQc','exemption') then 1 else 0 end) as qcTimeOutQty, sum (case when qb.qc_finish_time > qb.qc_date::timestamp + '1 day' and qb.qc_status = 'waitQc' then 1 else 0 end) as unQcTimeOutQty from qc_bill qb
qb.is_deleted = false
and qb.qc_date >= #{params.dateList[0]} and (#{params.dateList[1]}::TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '1 DAY' ) > qb.qc_date
group by qb.qc_user_id,qc_user_name

select qb.qc_date as qcDate, qb.qc_user_name as qcUserName, qb.code as qcCode, qb.purchase_order_code as purchaseOrderCode, qp.sku_id as skuId, qp.sku_no as skuNo, qi.qc_qty as qcQty, qb.qc_status as qcStatus, qb.qc_finish_time as qcEndTime from qc_bill qb inner join qc_info qi on qb.id = qi.main_id and qi.is_deleted = false inner join qc_product qp on qb.id = qp.main_id and qp.is_deleted = false
qb.is_deleted = false
and qb.qc_date >= #{params.dateList[0]} and (#{params.dateList[1]}::TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '1 DAY' ) > qb.qc_date
and qb.qc_status in
#{item}
and qb.qc_date::timestamp + '1 day' >= qb.qc_finish_time
and qb.qc_finish_time > qb.qc_date::timestamp + '1 day'
